'''Jallissi''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], or clan. A notable member of the clan was [[Tooga Jallissi Gral|Tooga Jalliissi Gral]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
While the Jallissi kajidic itself has never been mentioned, its existence is implied by the name of Tooga Jallissi Gral. According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', the [[cuirvas]] (or middle name) of a Hutt identified their clan.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>
